no_adcom_quote.quote: The application did not raise regulatory or scientific issues. The approval of another radiopharmaceutical (Choline C 11) was based on similar study design and endpoint (lesion localization rates verified by histopathology) in the same patient population (patients with elevated PSA levels suspected of cancer recurrence). For these reasons no advisory committee meeting was necessary.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the Axumin (fluciclovine F 18) NDA. The FDA review documents (Summary Review, Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, and Medical Review) each state that no AdComm was necessary, because the application did not raise regulatory or scientific issues and a similar radiopharmaceutical (Choline C 11) had already been approved on the same study design, endpoint, and patient population. There were therefore no committee-driven concerns or resulting changes to the approval.
